dataset_fields.title: Texas Water Well Reports (TDLR Submitted Driller's Reports)
dataset_fields.notes:
The Submitted Driller's Reports Database contains water well reports submitted to the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) from February 2001 to present (~680,000 statewide point records). Each record locates a reported well and carries attributes such as well type, proposed use, county, owner, completion date, and borehole depth.

Published by the Texas Water Development Board (TWDB) as a public ArcGIS FeatureServer and linked here as an external reference for the SUBSIDE catalog. It is also registered as the `well-reports` map overlay in the `subside-context` STAC collection (loaded viewport-by-viewport from the FeatureServer). Documentation: https://www.twdb.texas.gov/groundwater/data/drillersdb.asp

extras.collection_method_description: Water well reports submitted to TDLR by licensed drillers as a regulatory requirement.
extras.quality_assurance_description: Records reflect driller-submitted reports as received by TDLR; locations are not field-verified.
extras.caveats_usage: Well locations are derived from submitted driller's reports and may be approximate; records reflect reports as submitted to TDLR and have not been field-verified. Coverage begins February 2001, so wells completed earlier are generally not represented.
extras.attribution: Texas Water Development Board (TWDB) / Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR)

fields.description: Point layer of submitted water well reports (TDLR Submitted Driller's Reports, Feb 2001-present; ~680,000 features, EPSG:4326). Query via the ArcGIS REST API (f=geojson / f=json / PBF); maxRecordCount is 2,000, so consumers should page or query by bounding-box envelope.
